definitions.explanation: The month before this one; the previous month. Used to refer to events or states in the month that just passed.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦{新|あたら}しい→あたらしい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{車|くるま}→くるま：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→かう：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new car last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦{友達|ともだち}→ともだち：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いました→あう：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met my friend last month.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→いそがしい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{毎日|まいにち}→まいにち：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→しごと：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I was busy last month. I had work every day.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦{母|はは}→はは：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→にほん：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ました→くる：00254_kuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りました→かえる：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: My mother came to Japan last month, but she already went back.

examples.japanese: {先月|せんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→まいにち：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→あめ：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}りました→ふる：00839_furu⟧。⟦{今月|こんげつ}→こんげつ：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→てんき：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→よい：02350_yoi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦うれしい→うれしい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It rained every day last month. The weather is good this month, so I'm happy.

notes:
{先月|せんげつ} means 'last month' and is part of the time reference system.

TIME SERIES - MONTHS:
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: the month before last
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→こんげつ：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→らいげつ：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month
- ⟦{再来月|さらいげつ}→さらいげつ：01418_saraigetsu⟧: the month after next

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {先|せん}: previous, before
- {月|げつ}: month

SIMILAR WORDS WITH {先|せん}:
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→せんしゅう：00752_senshuu⟧: last week
- ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→せんじつ：03305_senjitsu⟧: the other day
- {先年|せんねん}: years ago, previous years

GRAMMAR NOTES:
- Used as time adverb without particle: {先月|せんげつ}{行|い}った (I went last month)
- Used as noun with の: {先月|せんげつ}の⟦{売|う}り{上|あ}げ→うりあげ：04102_uriage⟧ (last month's sales)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先月|せんげつ}の{末|まつ}: end of last month
- {先月|せんげつ}の⟦{初|はじ}め→はじめ：02931_hajime⟧: beginning of last month
